name: Death Row 💀
desc:
💀 - Wait your turn in line...

Your crimes have sentenced you to your worst fate. Cut your friends in line to die first or troll everyone by causing a lockdown. The choice is yours to make as your fate is given.

⭐- Favorite and leave a 👍like for more endings and updates!

Game is supported on all platforms PC 🖥️, mobile 📱, tablet 📟, and console 🎮
